stories.title: Clinical Trial Search Input/Output Schema
stories.description: Define Pydantic models for clinical trial search inputs (condition, location, radius, filters) and outputs (title, phase, summary, eligibility, locations, travel distance/time). Ensure validation and contract alignment with tool router.

stories.title: Clinical Trials Search Core Logic
stories.description: Implement core service logic to query ClinicalTrials.gov API with recruiting filter, parse results, extract required fields, and normalize trial data.

stories.title: Travel Distance and Time Enrichment
stories.description: Integrate Google Routes API to calculate travel distance and duration from user location to trial sites and append to trial results.

stories.title: Facade and Tool Router Integration
stories.description: Expose clinical trial search via EvaluateCare facade and register as an allowed tool in tool_router for LLM invocation, including input validation and response formatting.

stories.title: Clinical Trials Search Tests and Integration
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating schema enforcement, API response parsing, travel enrichment, and end-to-end invocation through facade and tool router.
stories.evidence: GAP: No existing dedicated clinical trials test file; must be created following backend/tests patterns
